policy: H009 and H035 were rewritten to avoid phrases repeatedly misrecognized across the first three inspected songs. Both candidates from the rewritten version are compared.

9.title: H009 — 日曜日のピクニック — 表現改訂版
rewrites: We discussed several conditions and turned them into a clear plan. -> We thought about several conditions and made a clear plan.
Although Mother was tired, she said she would prepare sandwiches. -> Mother was tired, but she said she would prepare sandwiches.

35.title: H035 — ダーウィンとガラパゴス — 表現改訂版
rewrites: Charles Darwin ... on board H.M.S. Beagle. -> In 1831, Charles Darwin began a voyage around the world aboard a British survey ship.
In the Galápagos ... -> On the Galapagos Islands, he carefully observed how animals varied from island to island.
